# Third-party notices

<!-- Generated by scripts/third_party_notices.py; edit the script, not the file. -->

Gezgin Compress is built from the open-source components listed below, each
under its own licence.

## Components with conditions

| Component | Licence | What it asks of us |
|---|---|---|
| `unrar`, `unrar_sys` (RAR reading) | MIT OR Apache-2.0 for the Rust code; the bundled UnRAR C++ source is under the **UnRAR licence** | The UnRAR source may be used to *extract* RAR archives only; it must not be used to re-create the RAR compression algorithm. Gezgin Compress only reads RAR. Freeware licence text: https://www.rarlab.com/license.htm |
| `colored`, `option-ext` | MPL-2.0 | File-level copyleft: changes to *those files* must stay MPL-2.0 and be published. Used unmodified. Source: crates.io. |
| `epaint` (egui painter) | (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND OFL-1.1 AND UFL-1.0 | Embeds the Hack, Noto Emoji and Ubuntu-Light fonts. The fonts keep their own licences (SIL Open Font Licence 1.1, Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0) and may not be sold on their own. |
| `libbz2-rs-sys` | bzip2-1.0.6 (BSD-style) | Keep the copyright notice: bzip2/libbzip2 (c) 1996-2010 Julian R Seward. |
| BSD / ISC / Zlib / BSL crates (table below) | permissive | Keep their copyright notices with binary redistributions; this file is that notice. |
